makePostFootnote: Make post opens the finished picture with the caption, ready to download or share. Each post uses that place’s own design if it has one, otherwise your single event post design.
weeklyBoxBlurb: One picture showing everywhere you’ll be this week.
eventBoxBlurb: One picture for one event: its date, place and times.
placePostBoxBlurb: Pick a place and post the next event you have there.
weeklyDesignBlurb: Your background picture for the weekly schedule post. Each week we write your days, places and times on top of it.
eventDesignUsedFor: every post about a single event.
useStandardLink: Use your single event post design here instead
emptyWeeklyTitle: You haven’t designed a weekly post yet
emptyEventTitle: You haven’t designed a single event post yet
emptyBody: Upload your picture in Designs first.
placePicturesBlurb: Save images for a location — a pub’s logo, a photo, a festival’s poster. Your designs decide where they appear: in an image box on your weekly or single event post, or as the whole background.
placePicturesPageLine: Images for this location. The one marked Main is used automatically; you can pick a different one when you make a post.
placeOwnPositionsLink: Own text positions for this location (optional)
imageChoicePrivate: Private bookings always use your standard design.
locationsBlurb: Give each location its images. They are used automatically when you make a post.
captionThisPostNote: Type straight in the box to change it for this post only. Your template stays as it is.
templatePanelBlurb: used for every single event post
templatePanelNote: The orange words fill in from each event. Saving updates the caption above and every future post.
locationsPickOne: Pick a location on the left to give it its images.
eventBoxPhotoBlurb: It goes in the photo space on your single event design, cropped to fill it. Any shape is fine.
eventBoxPosterBlurb: It replaces your standard design completely for events at this location.
eventBoxAddPhotoSpace: Add a photo space to your single event design to use any shape instead
weeklyBoxTitle: Picture beside its row on your weekly post
weeklyBoxBlurbLoc: A logo or a photo. It is drawn small, in the space your weekly design gives it.
weeklyUseEventImage: Use the event photo here too
weeklyNotOnLine: Your weekly design does not show a location picture yet, so this one will not appear until you switch it on in Designs.
imageChoiceOneOff: Upload one for this post only
tabCreateBlurb: Make a post for this week or for one event. We put your dates, places and times on your design, ready to download or share.
tabDesignsBlurb: Your two designs: one for the weekly schedule and one for single event posts. Set them up once — every post uses them.
tabLocationsBlurb: Pictures and social media tags for each location. They’re used automatically when you create a post.
weeklyPicBlurb: A logo or photo for this location’s line on your weekly post.
eventPicBlurb: A logo or photo in the picture space of your single event design.
pictureBoxBlurb: A logo or photo of this location. Any shape.
pictureWeeklyOff: Turn it on in your weekly design →
pictureEventNoSpace: Your single event design has no photo space yet — add one to show this picture on event posts →
picturePosterWins: This location has an event poster, so single event posts use the poster and this picture isn’t drawn on them.
captionSavedNote: Saved automatically · used next time too
shareCaptionNote: Facebook and Instagram don’t accept a ready-written caption from other apps — it’s copied, so just paste it in.
posterBoxBlurb: Got a ready-made poster for this location? Upload it and we’ll use it instead of your single event design.
pictureBoxBlurbV3: A logo or photo. Used wherever your designs have a picture space.
weeklyOnlyAddLink: + Use a different picture on weekly posts
weeklyOnlyBoxBlurb: Used on weekly posts instead of your location picture.
nameFromScheduleNote: Name and area come from your schedule. Edit them in Schedule › Events › Add event › Tidy up places.
leaveConfirmTitle: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
editorNothingSelected: Click anything on your post to change it
editorSettingsFor: Settings for the box you’ve picked
editorMoreSummary: Spacing, tilt, words before, line spacing, darken the picture, centre the box
editorMoreSummaryAll: Letter spacing, shadow strength, outline thickness, band corners, darken the picture
editorMoreSummaryBox: Words before, line spacing, tilt, long names, centre the box
allTextSample: Font, colour and effects for everything
followNote: Same font, colour and effects as All text
useForAllText: Use this style for all text
lookSameHint: Font, colour and effects come from All text. Pick “Its own style” to change them for this box only.
lookOwnHint: This box has its own font, colour and effects. Pick “Same as All text” to match the others again.
editorPreviewHint: Preview hides the box outlines so you see the finished post
bgPortraitTip: Tip: a portrait picture (1080 × 1350, 4:5) shows biggest on Instagram and Facebook feeds.
daysBlurb: One row for each day. Drag the orange box on your poster to move them, pull its corners to make the rows bigger or smaller.
daysPartsHint: Drag ⋮⋮ to change the order. To change how the words look, click them on your poster.
daysOffOmitHint: Days with nothing on are left blank.
previewPostHint: This is exactly what gets posted.
darkenHint: Puts a dark layer over your picture so white writing is easier to read.
newShapeReset: Your new picture is a different shape, so the boxes have moved to a starting position.
leaveBody: You’ve changed this design since you last saved.
settingsClicked: You clicked this on your poster. Change it here.
styleOwn: Style this one on its own
styleMatchHint: Font, colour and effects come from All text, so everything matches.
styleOwnHint: Font, colour and effects are set just for this.
textSizeHint: or drag a corner of the box on your poster
effectAutoHint: If the words are hard to read on your picture, we add a soft shadow. Your colours never change.
moreSummaryPlain: Space between letters · Tilt · Add words before it (like “From”) · If a name is too long: make it smaller or use two lines
wordsBeforeHint: Drawn in front of what this item says, like “From”. It shrinks to fit with the rest.
labelTooLong: If a name is too long
labelBandPadding: Space around the words in the strip
allTextSizeHint: Changes every box at once and keeps the big ones bigger.
backgroundSummary: Replace picture · Darken the picture · size advice
liveFontFallback: Your own uploaded font can’t be shown here, so that text is in Oswald while you edit. Press “👁 Preview post” to see it properly.
phonePicEventLine: In your single event design’s picture space
phonePicWeeklyLine: On this location’s line of your weekly post
phonePicPosterLine: Used instead of your single event design
phoneEditHint: Tap the writing on your poster, or pick something below, to change it
pageIntro: Designs is where you upload your background pictures, once. Make a post puts your dates, places and times on them for you.
eventDesignBlurb: Your standard design for a post about one event. We write that event’s date, place and times on top of it.
placeDesignScope: Event posts at {place} use this design. Everywhere else uses your single event post design.
standardDesignConfirm: Use your single event post design at {place}? Its own picture will be removed.
postNameHint: Printed on posts for this place. Leave it blank to use “{fullName}”.

removePictureConfirm.main: Remove “{label}”? It is this location’s Main image — the next one becomes Main.

weekEventsLine.withPrivate: {events, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} · {privateEvents, plural, one {# private event} other {# private events}} left out

imageSource.event: Using the image you uploaded for this post
imageSource.placePhoto: {hasPlace, select, yes {Using {place}’s photo} other {Using this location’s photo}}
imageSource.placePoster: {hasPlace, select, yes {Using {place}’s poster} other {Using this location’s poster}}
imageSource.standard: Using your standard single event design

eventBoxPosterShape: A poster has to be the same shape as your standard design ({w}×{h}), because your text boxes were placed on that shape.
slotRemoveConfirm: {what, select, poster {Remove this poster? It stops being used. The image itself is kept.} photo {Remove this photo? It stops being used. The image itself is kept.} other {Remove this picture? It stops being used. The image itself is kept.}}

posterBoxBlurbSized.plain: A full poster for events here. It replaces your standard single event design. We add the date, times and “Powered by HatchGrab”.
posterBoxBlurbSized.withSize: A full poster for events here. It replaces your standard single event design. We add the date, times and “Powered by HatchGrab”. Same shape as your standard design ({w} × {h}).

screen.imageTooBig: That image is {size}MB. The limit is 10MB.
screen.pngOrJpg: Please choose a PNG or JPG.
screen.eventPostsUseThat: Event posts now use that picture too.
screen.weeklyPostsUseThat: Weekly posts now use that picture too.
